tests.title: Authenticator and Config.Authenticate are exported with the specified shapes
given: the gatewayd package compiled in an external test package
tests.when: a function literal func(ctx context.Context, token string) (string, bool) is assigned to a gatewayd.Authenticator and to Config.Authenticate
then: the assignment compiles
a gatewayd.Authenticator value is assignable back to the bare func type
tests.pseudocode: var a gatewayd.Authenticator = func(ctx context.Context, tok string) (string, bool) { return 'p', true }; cfg := gatewayd.Config{Backend: b, Authenticate: a}; var f func(context.Context,string)(string,bool) = a

tests.title: New refuses a Config with both Tokens and Authenticate and leaks no token
given: a valid backend
two valid tokens
a non-nil authenticator
tests.when: gatewayd.New is called with Tokens non-empty and Authenticate non-nil
then: the returned *Server is nil
the error is non-nil and its text contains 'Tokens' and 'Authenticate'
the error text contains neither configured token
tests.pseudocode: s, err := gatewayd.New(Config{Backend:b, Tokens:[]string{Token,TokenB}, Authenticate:fn}); assert s == nil; assert err != nil; assert contains(err.Error(),'Tokens') && contains(err.Error(),'Authenticate'); assert !contains(err.Error(), Token) && !contains(err.Error(), TokenB)

tests.title: New refuses a Config with neither Tokens nor Authenticate, for nil and empty Tokens
given: a valid backend
tests.when: gatewayd.New is called once with nil Tokens and once with an empty non-nil Tokens slice, both with a nil Authenticate
then: both calls return a nil *Server
both errors are non-nil and their text contains 'Tokens' and 'Authenticate'
tests.pseudocode: for toks in [nil, []string{}]: s, err := New(Config{Backend:b, Tokens:toks}); assert s == nil; assert contains(err.Error(),'Tokens') && contains(err.Error(),'Authenticate')

tests.title: Static mode validates the token list with the unchanged spec 19 errors
given: a nil Authenticate
tests.when: New is called with a too-short token, a token with a non-printable byte, and a repeated token
then: each call returns an error starting 'gatewayd: Config.Tokens: '
each error text equals what token.Validate produces for that list, wrapped as in spec 19
a valid list returns a server and nil error
tests.pseudocode: for list in [short, nonprintable, dup]: _, err := New(Config{Backend:b, Tokens:list}); assert err.Error() == 'gatewayd: Config.Tokens: ' + token.Validate(list).Error()

tests.title: Callback mode skips token validation but keeps the other spec 19 checks
given: a non-nil Authenticate and empty Tokens
tests.when: New is called with a valid Backend; with a nil Backend; with a negative MaxSandboxes
then: the valid Config returns a non-nil *Server and nil error
the nil Backend returns the error 'gatewayd: Config.Backend is nil'
the negative limit returns the same error text spec 19 returns
tests.pseudocode: s, err := New(Config{Backend:b, Authenticate:fn}); assert err == nil && s != nil; _, err = New(Config{Authenticate:fn}); assert err.Error() == 'gatewayd: Config.Backend is nil'; _, err = New(Config{Backend:b, Authenticate:fn, MaxSandboxes:-1}); assert err.Error() == spec19Text

tests.title: Static mode refuses an unknown token in the tap and the interceptors with the spec 19 text
given: a gwtest server started with Config.Tokens only
tests.when: a unary RPC, a stream RPC and a call to a method no handler serves are made with a token not in the list, and a unary and a stream RPC are made with a configured token
then: each unknown-token RPC returns codes.Unauthenticated with message 'gatewayd: a valid bearer token is required'
the unserved method is refused with Unauthenticated, not Unimplemented
the configured-token RPCs succeed
tests.pseudocode: env := gwtest.Start(t, Config{Backend:b}); conn := env.Raw(t); for each rpc: err := invoke(Ctx(ctx, 'x'*40)); assert status.Code(err)==Unauthenticated && status.Convert(err).Message()=='gatewayd: a valid bearer token is required'

tests.title: In static mode the principal is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of any accepted token
given: a gwtest server whose Tokens hold the generated token
gwtest.Counting as the backend
tests.when: for any token of 32 to 64 printable ASCII bytes configured in Tokens, a client creates a sandbox with it
then: PrincipalFromContext on the backend's Create context returns ok == true
the principal equals hex.EncodeToString(sha256.Sum256(token)) and is 64 lowercase hex characters
tests.pseudocode: for tok in gen_tokens(32..64, printable): env := Start(Config{Backend:counting, Tokens:[tok]}); create(env.Dial(t,tok)); p, ok := counting.Principals()[0]; assert ok && p == hex(sha256(tok))

tests.title: Static mode logs the 8-character owner fingerprint and never the full hash
given: a static-mode server with a log capture
a token whose full hex SHA-256 is known
tests.when: a client creates a sandbox with that token
then: the 'sandbox created' record's owner equals the first 8 hex characters of the SHA-256
no log line contains the full 64-character hash or the token
tests.pseudocode: h := hex(sha256(Token)); rec := logs.Messages('sandbox created')[0]; assert rec['owner'] == h[:8]; assert !contains(logs.String(), h) && !contains(logs.String(), Token)

tests.title: Callback mode refuses missing, repeated, non-Bearer and empty authorization without calling the authenticator
given: a callback-mode server with an authenticator that counts its calls and accepts everything
tests.when: RPCs are sent with no authorization header, two authorization values, a 'Basic xyz' value, 'bearer x' lowercase prefix, and 'Bearer ' with an empty token
then: each RPC returns codes.Unauthenticated with message 'gatewayd: a valid bearer token is required'
the authenticator's call count stays 0
tests.pseudocode: for md in shapes: err := rawInvoke(md); assert Unauthenticated + message; assert calls.Load()==0

tests.title: The authenticator runs exactly once per unary RPC and per stream, with the tap context and the raw token
given: a callback-mode server whose authenticator records each call's token and whether peer.FromContext(ctx) is present
tests.when: one unary RPC, one stream and then RPCs with a 1-byte token, a 31-byte token and a token containing an internal space and punctuation are made
then: one call is recorded per unary RPC and one per stream
each recorded ctx carries a peer address
the recorded tokens equal the presented tokens byte for byte, without any server length or character rule
tests.pseudocode: unary(Ctx(ctx,'t1')); assert len(calls)==1; stream(Ctx(ctx,'t2')); assert len(calls)==2; for tok in ['a', 31 chars, 'a b~!=']: invoke(tok); assert calls.last.token == tok && calls.last.hasPeer

tests.title: A refused callback-mode RPC is stopped in the tap before any message is read and before any handler or backend runs
given: a callback-mode server whose authenticator returns ok == false
a counting backend
a raw gRPC connection
tests.when: unary and stream RPCs are made for served methods and for a method no handler serves
then: every RPC returns codes.Unauthenticated with message 'gatewayd: a valid bearer token is required'
the unserved method returns Unauthenticated, not Unimplemented
the backend recorded no Create, Reap or Sync call
tests.pseudocode: for m in [Create, Hello stream, '/x.Y/Z']: err := raw.Invoke(Ctx(ctx,'tok'), m); assert Unauthenticated; assert counting.Creates()==0 && counting.Reaps()==0

tests.title: An accepted principal reaches the backend's Create context and the authenticator is not called again
given: a callback-mode server whose authenticator maps 'tok-a' to principal 'tenant-1'
gwtest.Counting as backend
tests.when: a client creates a sandbox with 'tok-a'
then: PrincipalFromContext on the Create context returns ('tenant-1', true)
the authenticator's call count for that RPC is exactly 1 though the unary interceptor also ran
tests.pseudocode: sb := create(env.Dial(t,'tok-a')); assert counting.Principals()[0] == ('tenant-1', true); assert calls.Load()==1

tests.title: A callback-mode interceptor given a context without a principal refuses with Unauthenticated
given: an in-package test with a callback-mode Server and a log capture
a context that carries no principal
tests.when: unaryAuth and streamAuth are invoked directly with that context and a handler that records whether it ran
then: both return codes.Unauthenticated with message 'gatewayd: a valid bearer token is required'
the handler never runs
the authenticator is not called
the 'authentication refused' log carries reason 'refused'
tests.pseudocode: _, err := s.unaryAuth(context.Background(), req, info, handler); assert Unauthenticated; assert !ran; assert calls==0; assert logs.Messages('authentication refused')[0]['reason']=='refused'

tests.title: Revoking a token refuses later RPCs but leaves in-flight RPCs and the principal's sandboxes alone
given: a callback-mode server whose authenticator maps tokens 'tok-a' and 'tok-b' to principal P and can revoke 'tok-a' at runtime
a sandbox created with 'tok-a' and an execute tool call in flight under 'tok-a'
tests.when: 'tok-a' is revoked while the execute runs, then a later RPC with 'tok-a' is made, then List with 'tok-b'
then: the in-flight execute returns its normal result
the later 'tok-a' RPC returns codes.Unauthenticated
'tok-b' List still includes the sandbox
tests.pseudocode: start execute(sleep) under tok-a; revoke('tok-a'); assert execute result ok; assert Unauthenticated on List(tok-a); assert id in List(tok-b)

tests.title: An empty principal is refused and no sandbox is created
given: a callback-mode server whose authenticator returns ('', true) for 'tok-empty'
gwtest.Counting as backend
tests.when: a client calls Create with 'tok-empty'
then: the RPC returns codes.Unauthenticated
the backend's Create count is 0 and the registry holds no sandbox
tests.pseudocode: _, err := env.Dial(t,'tok-empty').Create(ctx, spec); assert Unauthenticated; assert counting.Creates()==0

tests.title: A 257-byte principal is refused and a 256-byte principal is accepted
given: a callback-mode server whose authenticator returns 257 'a' bytes for 'tok-long' and 256 'a' bytes for 'tok-max'
tests.when: Create is called with each token
then: 'tok-long' gets codes.Unauthenticated
'tok-max' succeeds and the backend sees a 256-byte principal
tests.pseudocode: assert Unauthenticated == code(create('tok-long')); assert create('tok-max') ok; assert len(counting.Principals()[0].p)==256

tests.title: A panicking authenticator is recovered and the server keeps serving
given: a callback-mode server whose authenticator panics for 'tok-boom' and accepts 'tok-ok'
one client connection used for both tokens
tests.when: an RPC with 'tok-boom' is made, then an RPC with 'tok-ok' on the same connection, then one on a new connection
then: the 'tok-boom' RPC returns codes.Unauthenticated
the process does not exit
both following RPCs succeed
tests.pseudocode: conn := env.Raw(t); assert Unauthenticated == code(invoke(conn,'tok-boom')); assert nil == invoke(conn,'tok-ok'); assert nil == invoke(env.Raw(t),'tok-ok')

tests.title: Any principal of 1 to 256 bytes reaches the backend unchanged
given: a callback-mode server whose authenticator returns the generated principal for 'tok'
gwtest.Counting as backend
tests.when: for any byte string of length 1 to 256, including non-ASCII, invalid UTF-8 and control bytes, used as the principal
then: Create succeeds
PrincipalFromContext returns exactly those bytes with ok == true
a second token mapping to the same bytes sees the sandbox, and one differing in a single byte does not
tests.pseudocode: for p in gen_bytes(1..256): set(authn, p); create(); assert counting.last.principal == p; assert list(tokSame) has id; assert list(tokOneByteOff) empty

tests.title: A second token of the same principal reaches the first token's sandbox through every RPC
given: a callback-mode server mapping 'tok-a' and 'tok-b' to principal P
a sandbox created with 'tok-a'
tests.when: with 'tok-b' the client calls List, runs a tool through the Agent relay, calls SyncGit, and finally calls Destroy
then: List includes the id
the relay tool call returns its result
SyncGit syncs the sandbox
Destroy removes it and the destroy log reason is 'client'
tests.pseudocode: sb := create(dial('tok-a')); pb := dial('tok-b'); assert id in pb.List(); assert run(pb.Attach(id)).ok; assert syncGit(pb,id) == nil; pb.Destroy(id); assert destroyReason(logs,id)=='client'

tests.title: A different principal gets the answers spec 19 gives for an unknown id
given: a callback-mode server mapping 'tok-p' to P and 'tok-q' to Q
a sandbox created under P
tests.when: with 'tok-q' the client calls List, Destroy, the Agent relay and SyncGit for that id
then: List omits the id
Destroy answers OK and the sandbox stays registered (still visible to 'tok-p')
the relay and SyncGit return codes.Unavailable with a message naming the id, identical to the answers for a random unknown id
tests.pseudocode: assert id not in qList(); assert qDestroy(id)==nil; assert id in pList(); for call in [relay, syncGit]: assert code==Unavailable && contains(msg,id) && msg == msgFor(unknownId)

tests.title: Callback mode logs the full principal as the owner of a created sandbox
given: a callback-mode server mapping 'tok-a' to principal 'tenant-1-lease-0042' with a log capture
tests.when: a client creates a sandbox with 'tok-a'
then: the 'sandbox created' JSON record's owner field equals 'tenant-1-lease-0042'
tests.pseudocode: assert logs.Messages('sandbox created')[0]['owner']=='tenant-1-lease-0042'

tests.title: Every authentication refusal logs the unchanged Warn message with peer and a reason, in both modes
given: a static-mode server and a callback-mode server, each with a log capture
tests.when: each server refuses one RPC with an unknown token
then: each log has a Warn record 'authentication refused'
the record has a non-empty peer attribute and a reason attribute whose value is one of 'no token', 'refused', 'invalid principal', 'panic'
tests.pseudocode: for env in [static, callback]: invoke(badToken); rec := logs.Messages('authentication refused')[0]; assert rec.level=='WARN' && rec['peer']!='' && rec['reason'] in {...}

tests.title: A missing, repeated, non-Bearer or empty header is logged with reason 'no token'
given: a static-mode server and a callback-mode server, each with a log capture
tests.when: RPCs are sent with no header, two headers, a Basic header and an empty Bearer token
then: each refusal record has reason == 'no token'
tests.pseudocode: for env, md in product(modes, shapes): invoke(md); assert logs.last('authentication refused')['reason']=='no token'

tests.title: A hash mismatch or an authenticator ok == false is logged with reason 'refused'
given: a static-mode server and a callback-mode server whose authenticator returns ok == false, each with a log capture
tests.when: an RPC with a well-formed but unaccepted token is made to each
then: each refusal record has reason == 'refused'
tests.pseudocode: invoke(static,'x'*40); invoke(callback,'nope'); assert both logs reason=='refused'

tests.title: An empty or over-long principal is logged with reason 'invalid principal'
given: a callback-mode server returning an empty principal for 'tok-empty' and a 257-byte principal for 'tok-long', with a log capture
tests.when: an RPC is made with each token
then: both refusal records have reason == 'invalid principal'
tests.pseudocode: invoke('tok-empty'); invoke('tok-long'); for rec in logs.Messages('authentication refused'): assert rec['reason']=='invalid principal'

tests.title: A recovered authenticator panic is logged with reason 'panic' and without the panic value
given: a callback-mode server whose authenticator panics with the string 'PANIC-SECRET-xyz' and a log capture
tests.when: an RPC is made
then: the refusal record has reason == 'panic'
the whole log output does not contain 'PANIC-SECRET-xyz'
tests.pseudocode: invoke('tok'); assert logs.Messages('authentication refused')[0]['reason']=='panic'; assert !contains(logs.String(),'PANIC-SECRET-xyz')

tests.title: No log line carries a token, panic value, full static hash, Env value or tool payload in either mode
given: a static-mode and a callback-mode server with log capture; the callback authenticator accepts a planted token and panics once for another token carrying a planted panic value
a Spec.Env value and a tool payload each containing a planted string
tests.when: clients create sandboxes with the planted token, run a tool with the planted payload, make refused RPCs, and destroy the sandboxes
then: the captured output of each server contains none of the planted token, panic value, Env value, tool payload or (static mode) the full 64-hex hash
tests.pseudocode: for env in modes: run flows; for s in planted: assert !contains(logs.String(), s)

tests.title: PrincipalFromContext is exported and nothing exported puts a principal on a context
given: the exported API of package gatewayd parsed with go/parser or go/doc
tests.when: the exported functions, methods and variables are enumerated
then: PrincipalFromContext has signature func(context.Context) (string, bool)
no other exported function takes a string and returns a context.Context, and no exported key variable or type exists for context values
tests.pseudocode: api := exported(gatewayd); assert api['PrincipalFromContext'].sig == 'func(context.Context)(string,bool)'; assert none(f for f in api.funcs if returns(f, context.Context) and f != nil_ok)

tests.title: The SyncGit and Gateway.Reap RPCs pass the principal to the backend
given: a callback-mode server mapping 'tok-a' to 'tenant-1'
gwtest.Counting as backend and a created sandbox
tests.when: the client calls SyncGit and then the Reap RPC with 'tok-a'
then: the sandbox's Sync context carried ('tenant-1', true)
the Backend.Reap context carried ('tenant-1', true)
tests.pseudocode: syncGit(p, id); reapRPC(p); assert counting.SyncPrincipals()[0]==('tenant-1',true); assert counting.ReapPrincipals()[last]==('tenant-1',true)

tests.title: The periodic reap carries no principal at Serve start and on every interval
given: a server with a short ReapInterval and gwtest.Counting as backend, in either mode
tests.when: the server starts and waits until at least three reaps have been recorded with no client RPC
then: every recorded Reap result is ('', false)
tests.pseudocode: env := Start(Config{Backend:counting, Authenticate:fn, ReapInterval:20ms}); eventually(len(counting.ReapPrincipals())>=3); for r in ReapPrincipals(): assert r == ('', false)

tests.title: Server-initiated Close calls use a background context with no principal for client, expired, unavailable, shutdown and Create error paths
given: a callback-mode server wrapping a backend whose sandboxes record the Close context
sandboxes ended by a client Destroy, a short TTL expiry, a dead backend sandbox found on access, Shutdown, and a Create whose post-create step fails
tests.when: each removal occurs
then: each recorded Close context has PrincipalFromContext == ('', false)
each has no deadline, is never cancelled and carries no values (equivalent to context.Background())
tests.pseudocode: for scenario in scenarios: trigger(); c := rec.closeCtx; assert principal(c)==('',false); assert c.Done()==nil; assert deadline(c) absent

tests.title: PrincipalFromContext reports no principal on contexts the server did not make
given: context.Background()
a context with the string-keyed value 'principal' set to 'x'
a context derived from a server-made context's parent but not from the server
tests.when: PrincipalFromContext is called on each
then: each call returns ("", false)
tests.pseudocode: for c in [Background(), WithValue(Background(),'principal','x')]: p, ok := PrincipalFromContext(c); assert p=='' && !ok

tests.title: Server.Destroy removes any held sandbox through the removal path with reason 'embedder' and the caller's ctx
given: a callback-mode server with a short-TTL-capable registry and a log capture
a sandbox created under principal P whose backend Close records its context
a caller ctx carrying a test value
tests.when: the embedder calls Server.Destroy(ctx, id)
then: the call returns nil
the backend's Close count rises by 1 and the Close context carries the caller's test value
'sandbox destroyed' is logged with reason 'embedder'
the TTL timer is stopped: no 'expired' destroy log follows after the TTL passes
tests.pseudocode: id := create(); err := srv.Destroy(ctx, id); assert err==nil; assert closes==1 && closeCtx.Value(k)==v; assert destroyReason(logs,id)=='embedder'; sleep(ttl); assert no second destroy log

tests.title: A failing Close or cancelled ctx leaves the entry removed and returns the wrapped error
given: a sandbox whose backend Close returns a sentinel error, and another whose Close returns ctx.Err()
tests.when: Server.Destroy is called with a live ctx for the first and with an already-cancelled ctx for the second, then again for each id
then: the first error names the id and errors.Is reaches the sentinel
the second error names the id and errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) holds
the entries are removed (List omits them)
the second Destroy for each id returns an error matching ErrNotHeld
tests.pseudocode: err := srv.Destroy(ctx,id); assert contains(err.Error(),id) && errors.Is(err, sentinel); assert id not in list(); assert errors.Is(srv.Destroy(ctx,id), gatewayd.ErrNotHeld)

tests.title: Destroy of an id not held returns ErrNotHeld naming the id and calls no backend method
given: gwtest.Counting as backend
ids that are unknown, already removed by client Destroy, by expiry, by a previous embedder Destroy
a server not yet serving and a server after Shutdown
tests.when: Server.Destroy is called for each id
then: each returns an error with errors.Is(err, gatewayd.ErrNotHeld)
each error text contains the id
gatewayd.ErrNotHeld.Error() == 'gatewayd: sandbox not held'
the backend's Close count does not change
tests.pseudocode: for id in cases: err := srv.Destroy(ctx,id); assert errors.Is(err, ErrNotHeld) && contains(err.Error(), id); assert counting.Closes()==before

tests.title: A Destroy while Create is still in progress returns ErrNotHeld
given: a backend whose Create has returned but a hook blocks gatewayService.Create before the entry is recorded (Counting.SetAfterCreate)
tests.when: the embedder learns the backend sandbox id and calls Server.Destroy(ctx, id) during the block, then the block is released
then: Destroy returns an error matching ErrNotHeld
the backend Close count is unchanged by Destroy
after release the Create RPC completes normally
tests.pseudocode: SetAfterCreate(func(){ id=last.ID(); err=srv.Destroy(ctx,id); signal }); create(); assert errors.Is(err, ErrNotHeld); assert closes==0

tests.title: A concurrent removal winning the race closes the backend once and Destroy returns nil
given: many held sandboxes with a Close that counts calls
tests.when: for each sandbox, Server.Destroy and a client Destroy RPC (or the expiry timer) race on the same entry
then: every Server.Destroy returns nil or an error matching ErrNotHeld and never another error
each backend sandbox's Close is called exactly once in total
each id gets exactly one 'sandbox destroyed' log
tests.pseudocode: parallel for id in ids: go srv.Destroy(ctx,id); go client.Destroy(id); wait; for id: assert closeCount[id]==1 && count(destroyLogs[id])==1

tests.title: After an embedder Destroy the client sees what it sees after expiry
given: a client holding a sandbox with an execute tool call about to be issued
a callback-mode server
tests.when: the embedder calls Server.Destroy, then the client makes another proxy tool call, List, a client Destroy, and SyncGit
then: the proxy call returns the sandbox_unavailable error
List omits the id
the client Destroy answers OK
SyncGit returns codes.Unavailable naming the id
tests.pseudocode: srv.Destroy(ctx,id); _, err := toolOf(sb,'execute').Run(...); assert isSandboxUnavailable(err); assert id not in list(); assert provider.Destroy(id)==nil; assert Unavailable == code(syncGit(id))

tests.title: The agentkit-gateway command stays in static mode and logs refusals with reason 'no token' or 'refused'
given: the command's run function started in process with a --token-file
a log capture
tests.when: an RPC with no token and an RPC with a wrong token are made, and run.go is inspected
then: the refusal records have reason 'no token' and 'refused' respectively and an unchanged message and peer
run.go populates Config.Tokens and contains no assignment to Authenticate
the flags and exit codes tests of the command are unchanged
tests.pseudocode: stop := runCommand(tokenFile); invoke(noToken); invoke(wrong); assert reasons == ['no token','refused']; assert !contains(source('run.go'),'Authenticate')

tests.title: Static mode keeps spec 19's refusals, status codes, texts and log messages, adding only reason
given: a static-mode server with a log capture
tests.when: a refused RPC is made and the 'authentication refused' record is read
then: the status is codes.Unauthenticated with message 'gatewayd: a valid bearer token is required'
the record is at Warn level and its attributes are exactly msg, level, time, peer and reason
tests.pseudocode: err := invoke('x'*40); assert code==Unauthenticated && msg==text; rec := logs.Messages('authentication refused')[0]; assert keys(rec)-{time,level,msg} == {peer, reason}

tests.title: gwtest.Start defaults Tokens only when both Tokens and Authenticate are unset
given: gwtest.Start called with three Configs
tests.when: Start is called with an empty Config, with Authenticate set, and with explicit Tokens
then: the first server accepts Token and TokenB
the second runs in callback mode with Tokens left empty and accepts exactly what its authenticator accepts
the third keeps the explicit list unchanged
tests.pseudocode: e1 := Start(t, Config{Backend:b}); assert e1.Dial(t,Token) ok && e1.Dial(t,TokenB) ok; e2 := Start(t, Config{Backend:b, Authenticate:fn}); assert Token refused unless fn accepts it

tests.title: gwtest.Counting records the PrincipalFromContext result of every Create, Reap and Sync
given: a callback-mode server with gwtest.Counting as backend
tests.when: a client creates a sandbox, calls SyncGit and the Reap RPC, and the periodic reap runs
then: the accessors return one (principal, ok) pair per Create, per Reap (RPC and periodic) and per sandbox Sync
RPC-driven entries carry the principal with ok == true and the periodic Reap carries ('', false)

tests.title: The gatewayd exported surface gains exactly five identifiers and the protocol constants are unchanged
given: the exported identifiers of gatewayd as listed by spec 19, recorded in a golden list
tests.when: the exported API of sandbox/gatewayd (including methods and struct fields) is enumerated and compared with the golden list, and sandbox.ProtocolMinor and the proto hashes are read

sandbox.ProtocolMinor == 2
gateway.proto.sha256 and sandbox.proto.sha256 match the files

tests.title: An unchanged sandbox/gateway Provider works against servers in both modes
given: one static-mode and one callback-mode server over local through gwtest
tests.when: the same client code (Provider.Create, List, tool call through the relay, Destroy) runs against each
then: every call succeeds with identical client-visible results in both modes
tests.pseudocode: for env in [static, callback]: p := env.Dial(t,tok); sb := create(p); assert run(sb,'echo hi')=='hi'; assert id in p.List(); assert p.Destroy(id)==nil

tests.title: An embedder authenticates a lease token, the backend sees the principal at Create, and a tool runs through the relay
given: gatewayd.New(Config{Backend: counting, Authenticate: fn}) served on gwtest's in-memory listener
a log capture
tests.when: a client dials with sandbox/gateway, creates a sandbox with a lease token, and runs a tool through the relay
then: the authenticator was called once for the Create RPC
the backend recorded the principal the authenticator returned with ok == true

the tool result reaches the client

tests.title: The embedder ends a leased sandbox mid-call and the client sees it gone
given: a callback-mode server with gwtest.Counting
a client with a sandbox and a long tool call in flight
tests.when: the embedder calls Server.Destroy(ctx, id), the client issues its next proxy call and List, and the embedder calls Destroy again

tests.title: Two tokens of one principal share a sandbox until one is revoked
given: a callback-mode server mapping token A and token B to principal P and token C to principal Q, with a revocable authenticator and a log capture
tests.when: A creates a sandbox, B lists, C lists and calls SyncGit for the id, token A is revoked, A makes an RPC, then B reaches the sandbox
then: B's List includes the sandbox
C's List omits it and C's SyncGit returns codes.Unavailable naming the id
A's RPC after revocation returns codes.Unauthenticated and the log has reason 'refused'
B still reaches the sandbox through the relay

tests.title: A static-mode server exposes the token hash as the principal and logs only its 8-character fingerprint
given: a server started through gwtest.Start with Config.Tokens only and gwtest.Counting as backend
a log capture
tests.when: a client creates a sandbox with Token
then: the backend recorded the 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 of Token as principal with ok == true
'sandbox created' was logged with the first 8 hex characters as owner
no log line contains the full hash
